Starts off good but falls off hard pretty quickly. It's trying to be dungeon crawler and base management game but it's unfortunately pretty shallow in both of those when it comes to the depth. Combat gets very boring with very low variety (weapons are mostly about attack rate), and hence doing dungeons consecutively gets boring fast (especially if you are used to good roguelite dungeon crawlers like Hades). Base Management is very shallow with every day repetitive tasks that gets annoying after a while. (Talking to individuals for level raise, every day doing sermons, devotion becoming very slow to get mid-game and onwards, more decorations than actual useful base management buildings, etc. etc.). Unique theme + gorgeous art style + being an indie game is enough to get very high review score it seems, but I do not think this is a game that deserves so high rating. Better play Hades.

Resident Evil 4 Remake is the best Resident Evil game I've ever played, a true masterpiece. The gameplay, graphics, atmosphere, characters and sound design are incredible. 
The game can be really scary and stressful, especially when those idiots come after you making those creepy noises. But as you progress, the fear slowly turns into excitement(just a little bit), and you become more confident in fighting them. 
I also love how Leon and Luis aren't friends at first, but they end up helping each other a lot. 
Leon and Ashley also develop trust in each other throughout the game, which makes their journey even more enjoyable. 
The environments look amazing, and the combat is an absolute masterclass.
Absolutely worth playing!
